pakej.heading: Our Catering Packages
pakej.intro: Three core packages for every event size — Jimat, Standard and Premium. Add Air Balang juice barrels to refresh your guests. All prices include nasi minyak, mains and basic on-site service.
pakej.fallbackJimat: Nasi minyak, ayam merah, acar timun and papadom — value pick for mid-size events.
pakej.fallbackStandard: Pakej Jimat plus daging hitam — hearty spread for typical kenduri kahwin.
pakej.fallbackPremium: Full spread with daging hitam, fresh fruit and kuih — ideal for marquee events.
pakej.fallbackAirBalang: Orange, rose or grape barrel juice — RM80 per 50-guest barrel.

reviews.heading: What Customers Say on Google
reviews.r1Body: Booked Pakej Premium for our 250-pax wedding. Nasi minyak was outstanding, daging hitam fall-apart tender and the crew were so professional. Guests raved through the night. Already lining them up for next year's aqiqah.
reviews.r2Body: Ordered Pakej Standard for a 150-guest event at our family home. Delivered at 11am sharp as promised, every dish steaming hot. The acar timun and ayam merah are the real stars — thank you AuntyRokiah Katering.
reviews.r3Body: We threw a 60-pax doa selamat with short notice and AuntyRokiah still squeezed us in. Pakej Jimat plus a rose-syrup barrel — every guest ate their fill. Pricing is genuinely fair for the quality served.
reviews.r4Body: Used them for a 200-staff office event. Pakej Premium with fruit and kuih hit the spot, layout was tidy and halal compliance was visible. The CEO praised both setup and timing — we'll re-book next year.
reviews.r5Body: Hosted my son's aqiqah near Lake Gardens Seremban. Pakej Standard with daging hitam was a hit — guests went back for seconds and thirds. Kak Rokiah personally rang to confirm the date — a lovely human touch.
reviews.r6Body: Raya open house in Wangsa Maju, Pakej Premium for 180 guests. Fresh fruit, plenty of kuih variety and nasi minyak that tasted of childhood. Crew packed everything down after — nothing left for the host to handle.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How much does catering cost per pax in Malaysia?
faq.a1: AuntyRokiah Katering packages start at RM15/pax for Pakej Jimat, RM21/pax for Pakej Standard and RM25/pax for Pakej Premium. Prices include nasi minyak, main dishes and basic serving crew. Add-on Air Balang barrels are RM80 each, serving up to 50 guests. WhatsApp us for a full estimate tailored to your guest count.
faq.q2: Which wedding catering package suits 200 guests?
faq.a2: For a 200-guest wedding, we recommend Pakej Standard or Pakej Premium depending on budget. Pakej Standard delivers nasi minyak, ayam merah, daging hitam, acar and papadom in a neat tray layout. Pakej Premium adds fresh fruit and kuih, giving relatives and invited guests a more memorable, fuller-spread experience.
faq.q3: Does AuntyRokiah Katering offer aqiqah packages?
faq.a3: Yes, all three core packages suit aqiqah events from small 30-pax gatherings to 500+ guest celebrations. We can coordinate halal-slaughtered meat sourcing and arrange the spread according to your family's traditions. Many hosts pick Pakej Standard for family-size aqiqah, or Pakej Premium for combined aqiqah and doa selamat ceremonies.
faq.q4: Doa selamat catering — how much notice do you need?
faq.a4: Ideally 7 days before the event so fresh ingredients can be planned and crew scheduled. For smaller doa selamat under 60 pax, we can accept last-minute bookings within 48 hours subject to kitchen availability. Weekends during wedding season fill quickly — WhatsApp us as early as you can to secure the date.
faq.q5: Raya open house catering — do you accept multi-day bookings?
faq.a5: Yes, we accept bookings across the entire Syawal and Aidiladha period. Many families pick Pakej Premium for the first day and Pakej Standard for the seventh day onward. We offer flexible delivery slots based on your invite waves — message us on WhatsApp to design a Raya-season catering schedule that fits.
faq.q6: Do you offer tea-time catering for office events?
faq.a6: Yes, we offer a tea-time menu built on Pakej Jimat with extra traditional kuih and neatly cut fresh fruit. It suits office townhalls, staff farewells and afternoon family gatherings. For formal corporate events, Pakej Standard or Premium gives a tidier tray-layout presentation that matches your company branding.
faq.q7: Corporate catering — do you cover Cyberjaya and Putrajaya?
faq.a7: Yes, AuntyRokiah Katering is active across the Klang Valley including Cyberjaya, Putrajaya, Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya. We handle townhalls, product launches, department lunches and company retreats. Our team brings its own service equipment, hits timing on the dot and arranges trays to match a corporate look-and-feel.
faq.q8: Air Balang add-on — how many barrels for 200 guests?
faq.a8: One barrel serves about 50 guests, so for 200 guests we recommend 4 barrels as a starting point. Many hosts mix flavours — for example 2 orange and 2 rose-syrup barrels — to give guests a choice. The RM80 price per barrel includes the barrel itself, disposable cups and a working tap fitting.
